text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Telefonica buys shares of (Antena 3 chairman) Asensio in Antena 3 Television
- (Italy's Silvio and Paolo) Berlusconi and De la Rosa, charged for tax crime in management of Tele 5
- European commission demands government change its digital (television) law
- Judge Coronado testifies for presumed lying
- Swiss banks reveal the secret accounts that have been "dormant" since 1945
EL MUNDO
- (Judge) Garzon registers Tele 5 for a presumed tax crime by the Berlusconi team
- Telefonica negotiates with Asensio for the purchase of a controlling package of A-3
DIARIO 16
- The tele is of (Deputy Prime Minister) Cascos:
Telefonica buys the 25 percent of Antena 3 that Asensio had
At the same time judge Garzon destroys headquarters of Telecinco in search of crimes by former managers
Only Europe protects the plurality of television giving the government one month to change its digital law
ABC
- Telefonica approves of purchase the 25 percent of Antena 3 TV from Asensio
CINCO DIAS

- Telefonica gives a blow to Antena 3: Asensio gives up majority and chairmanship after evaluating the channel at 92.5 billion; (Telefonica chairman) Villalonga aligns with BCH and Santander, each one with 25 percent of Antena 3; Brussels gives new setback to Digital Television law of Aznar's government
- Bourse boom: Europe up, and Spain, at a bridge
EXPANSION
- Government reduces by half its unemployment contribution
- Telefonica buys 25 percent of Antena 3 Television from Antonio Asensio
- European Commission gives green light to merger of Boeing and McDonnell
- LVMH already has more than 10 percent of Guiness and GrandMet and could put their merger into question
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- The sharp rise of the dollar makes vacations and gasoline - Subsidies cost the state 2.3 trillion in 1996
- Public deficit through June is at 1.7 percent of GDP
